title: 第1章  和女主抢抢人
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
“殿下！您看这个，体格健壮，绝对耐玩！”
“您看看这个，虽然瘦弱点，但很敏感，一鞭子下去叫起来特别带劲。”
“还有这个，怎么打都不会还手，打狠了会哭着求饶，特别能满足征服欲……”
夜间的奴隶场，贪婪勾缠无尽欲望。
奴隶主们迫不及待地迎上前，一脸激动。
谁不知这位三公主殿下，虽然只是个C级雌性，精神力弱得可怜，却挥金如土。
能特意来这不入流的小奴场……
想必是特意来挑些雄性奴隶回去折磨着玩的。
姜知夏听得眼角直抽。
这是她穿越到这个星际兽世的第三天。
上辈子她还是个累死累活的牛马，猝死在办公桌上，一睁眼，发现自己穿成了公主，恨不得当场挂两串鞭炮庆祝。
但等彻底和这具身体的记忆融合以后，她沉默了。
他喵的，是穿书了。
这本书她曾经看过，大概讲的是中央帝国流落在外的S级雌性真千金，在找回后，被两个哥哥疼爱，被父亲母亲捧在手心，同时和十几位优秀雄性无限暧昧拉扯，最后和和美美NP结局的故事。
她当时看得还挺起劲，毕竟看着这么多优秀男人为了女主互相争风吃醋扯头花，还是挺爽的。
但她没穿成女主。
她穿成了女主的对照组，假千金姜知夏。
当初看书的时候，她就对这个和自己同名同姓的角色感到一阵不适。
倒不是因为角色有多恶毒，说实话，比起那些动不动就下药陷害买凶杀人的标准女配，原主其实没犯什么大错，不过就是好色花痴了点，脾气骄纵了点，精神力低了点。
可作者似乎把所有的恶意都倾注在了这个角色身上。

真千金一回归，曾经宠爱她的父母立刻视她为鸠占鹊巢的骗子，护着她的两个哥哥厌恶她，觉得她这些年抢走了妹妹的一切，喜欢的雄性对她恶语相向，贵族圈里原本围绕她的人纷纷倒戈嘲笑她。
在后来剧情中，即使原主二次觉醒，精神力飞跃，成为帝国稀少的S级雌性，还是死在了女主光环的碾压下。
她最后被剥夺一切，流放至荒星被活活饿死。
而同时，女主正和她的后宫们腻歪着呢。
姜知夏气愤归气愤，万万没想到自己有朝一日穿进来了。
于是她穿越后疯狂思索，发现一件事。
现在剧情线还早，她还有的救。
距离真千金回归，还有两年的时间。
而她的精神力还没有二次觉醒，是个C级。
自己现在能做的，就是在真千金回归之前，整点傍身的东西。
原主因为精神力低弱，养成了用挥霍来掩饰自卑的性格，这导致虽然她每月的生活费不少，但一查账户，发现这货是个月光族。
原主虽然是雌性，但精神力弱得要死，又因为是公主，娇纵得什么事也不愿意做，所以她在帝国没有任何职务，纯粹是个装饰品。
她思考了整整一夜，最后只能锁定在“人”身上。
她打算试着和女主抢抢人。
当然，不是抢那些对女主死心塌地的男主们，她要抢的，是那些在剧情中没被女主看上眼，但却比较重要的角色。
说白了就是女主鱼塘里的鱼苗。
就比如说后期女主身边最忠诚的护卫，陆决。
陆决是罪臣后裔，家族在两年前倒台，全家处决的处决，流放的流放，而他被贬为奴隶，流落至奴隶场。
女主出现时，他已经在这个鬼地方被折磨了整整四年，奄奄一息，女主买下他后给他治伤，换来了陆决掏心掏肺的忠诚。
现在她提前两年来，让他换个目标忠诚，不好吗？

姜知夏一边想着，一边往里走。
原著描写陆决是狼族，脸上被刺了代表“罪奴”的刺青。
她走了快十分钟，都没有看见符合特征的目标。
旁边的奴隶主还在喋喋不休介绍，她冷淡地打断。
“有没有罪奴？最好是狼族的。”
奴隶主愣了一下。
来买罪奴的雌性，十个里有九个都是为了发泄怒气，买回去肆意鞭打折磨的。
看来这位三公主，真的是来买泄愤玩具的。
旁边一个一直挤不进来的奴隶主眼前一亮。
“有！殿下，我手里有一个！”
姜知夏眉头一跳，抬抬下巴：“带路。”
奴隶主忙不迭地点头，引着她往深处走去。
越往里走，血腥味越发浓重。
最终，他们在一个笼子前停下。
笼子窄小，上面蒙着厚重的黑布，像个大型狗笼。
奴隶主一边讨好地笑着，一边掀开黑布。
“这个奴隶还没完全驯服，但是身体壮实耐打，年轻，恢复力也快，可以玩很久……”
笼子里，陆决默默听着自己的“优点”。
他看了一眼自己被铁链捆住的手脚，咬了咬嘴里的止咬器。
是谁呢？

不管是谁，给他个痛快吧。
不要再折磨他了。
光线涌入，他一时睁不开眼。
模糊的视野里，他看到一个纤细的身影站在笼外。
一股好闻的馨香，瞬间刺破这里腐朽肮脏的血腥味儿，冲入他的鼻腔。
他眯起眼睛，努力抬头，想看清这个轮廓。
逆光中，他只能看到一双瞬间亮起的眼睛。
然后听见一个声音，清脆又明媚。
“就他了！”
content_en:
"Your Highness! Look at this, he has a strong physique and is absolutely durable!"
"Look at this. Although it is thin, it is very sensitive. When it is whipped, it screams with great force."
"And this one, no matter how hard you hit me, you won't fight back. If you hit me hard, you'll cry and beg for mercy. It can especially satisfy your desire to conquer..."
In the slave farm at night, greed entwines endless desires.
The slave owners rushed forward eagerly, with excitement on their faces.
Who doesn't know that this third princess, although she is only a C-level female with pitifully weak mental strength, spends money like water?
To be able to come to this low-class slave place...
They must have specially selected some male slaves to torture and play with.
Jiang Zhixia's eyes twitched when she heard this.
This is the third day since she traveled to this interstellar beast world.
In her previous life, she was still a tired ox and horse. She died suddenly on her desk. When she opened her eyes, she found that she was dressed as a princess and wanted to hang two strings of firecrackers on the spot to celebrate.
But after completely integrating with the memory of this body, she fell silent.
He's wearing a book.
She had read this book before, and it probably told the story of an S-class female true daughter of the Central Empire who was living abroad. After being found, she was loved by her two brothers, held in the palms of her father and mother, and had endless affairs with more than a dozen outstanding males, and finally ended up with a beautiful NP.
She was quite excited to watch it at the time. After all, it was quite refreshing to see so many outstanding men competing with each other for the heroine.
But she wasn't dressed as a heroine.
She dressed as the heroine's control group, the fake daughter Jiang Zhixia.
When she first read the book, she felt uncomfortable with this character who had the same name as herself.
It’s not because of how vicious the character is. To be honest, compared to the standard female supporting characters who easily drugged, framed and hired murderers, the original protagonist actually didn’t make any big mistakes, but she was just a little bit lustful, a bit arrogant, and a bit low on mental strength.
But the author seems to have poured all his malice into this character.
As soon as the real daughter returned, her parents who once doted on her immediately regarded her as a liar who had taken over the magpie's nest. The two brothers who protected her hated her and felt that she had taken away everything from their sister over the years.
In the later plot, even though the original owner awakened for the second time, made a leap in spiritual power and became a rare S-class female in the empire, she still died under the crushing influence of the heroine's halo.
In the end, she was deprived of everything, exiled to the Desolate Star, and starved to death.
At the same time, the heroine was enjoying herself with her harem.
Jiang Zhixia was so angry that she never thought that one day she would walk in.
So she thought crazily after traveling through time and discovered something.
It's still early in the plot line, and she can still be saved.
There are still two years left before the real daughter returns.
And her mental power has not yet awakened for the second time, so she is a C level.
What he can do now is to get some things close to him before the true daughter returns.
Due to her weak mental strength, the original owner developed a character of using squandering to cover up her low self-esteem. This led to the fact that although she had a lot of monthly living expenses, when she checked her account, she found that she was a moonlighter.
Although the original owner was a female, her mental strength was extremely weak, and because she was a princess, she was too pampered to do anything, so she had no position in the empire and was purely an ornament.
She thought about it all night, and finally she could only focus on "people".
She plans to try to steal someone from the heroine.
Of course, she is not robbing the male protagonists who are devoted to the heroine. What she wants to rob is those characters who are not favored by the heroine in the plot, but are relatively important.
To put it bluntly, they are the fry in the heroine's fish pond.
For example, the most loyal guard around the heroine in the later period is Lu Jue.
Lu Jue is a descendant of a guilty minister. His family collapsed two years ago. The whole family was executed and exiled. He was demoted to a slave and exiled to a slave farm.
When the heroine appeared, he had already been tortured in this hellish placeHe lived for four whole years and was dying. The heroine bought him and treated his injuries in exchange for Lu Jue's heartfelt loyalty.
Now, wouldn't it be good if she came two years in advance to let him change his loyalty?
Jiang Zhixia walked inside while thinking.
The original work describes Lu Jue as a member of the wolf clan, with a tattoo on his face representing "sin slave".
She walked for almost ten minutes and didn't see any target that matched the characteristics.
The slave owner next to her was still chattering about introductions, but she interrupted coldly.
"Are there any sin slaves? Preferably from the wolf clan."
The slave owner was stunned for a moment.
Nine out of ten females who come to buy sin slaves are bought to vent their anger and are whipped and tortured.
It seems that the third princess really came to buy toys to vent her anger.
A slave owner next to him who had been unable to squeeze in suddenly lit up.
"Yes! Your Highness, I have one in my hand!"
Jiang Zhixia's brows twitched and she raised her chin: "Lead the way."
The slave owner nodded hurriedly and led her deeper.
The further inside, the stronger the smell of blood becomes.
Finally, they stopped in front of a cage.
The cage was narrow and covered with thick black cloth, like a large dog cage.
The slave owner smiled ingratiatingly while lifting the black cloth.
"This slave is not completely tamed yet, but he is strong and durable, young, and has quick recovery. He can play for a long time..."
In the cage, Lu Jue listened silently to his "advantages".
He glanced at his hands and feet bound by iron chains and bit the bite stopper in his mouth.
Who is it?
Whoever it is, give him a good time.
Stop torturing him.
Light flooded in and he couldn't open his eyes for a moment.
In his blurred vision, he saw a slender figure standing outside the cage.
A pleasant fragrance instantly pierced the rotten, dirty smell of blood here and rushed into his nostrils.
He squinted his eyes and tried to raise his head, trying to see the outline clearly.
In the backlight, he could only see a pair of eyes that lit up instantly.
Then I heard a voice, clear and bright.
"It's him!"
